name: The Bottle Imp
summary: A trick-taking game where low cards win the cursed Bottle whose price keeps dropping, making its owner lose.
rules_text: 36 numbered suit cards are dealt evenly. Each player discards one face-down under the start price card 19 to form the Imp's Trick, then passes one card face-down to each neighbor. In clockwise tricks, players must follow suit if able. If all cards played are above the current bottle price, the highest card wins the trick. If any card is below the price, the highest card below the price wins the trick and takes the Bottle Imp, and that winning card becomes the new bottle price, placed on the Bottle card. The previous price card goes to the former bottle owner as a won card. Play until hands empty. Players normally score coin points on won cards, but the final bottle owner scores only the Imp's Trick coins as negative points, ignoring their won pile. Play several hands to 200 points.
